coordinateContract: Every rect is ABSOLUTE screen logical pixels. parent is a prior action key in the same family; convert to native parent-local only while operating the normal UI.

operationContract.panel: native 9-slice panel, skin is an existing exact staging URL; no composite artwork/text baked
operationContract.button: native compound button: Btn wrapper + BG skin + separate native Txt label, default pressed tint; child image/text/group must pass input to owner
operationContract.plain: raw container with fill/strokeWidth/radius/opacity1; overflow optional clip/scroll-y
operationContract.image: existing URL image with exact atlas region optional; never a reference JPG
operationContract.text: native text with exact fixture copy; size/weight/color/align are production proposals

globalNotes: Only root executes normal UI. This action list is not a stored screen model and is not for JSON import/injection.
Parent keys topological; native stable IDs are assigned/preserved by the normal tool.
All native modal contents stand alone: no duplicated behind-page or screenshot. Root configures existing overlay policy.
3D Slot_3D is full-screen empty plain plus label; never insert a 2D character/world picture into it.
Default representative state only. Different source times/hero/count variants are notes rather than mixed UI.
Unsupported native input/tabs/toggle operations are not invented here: root uses existing native controls as explained in family notes.
All links are proposed source-evidence connections, not completed game logic or unobserved actions.
